patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

OpenCart and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose OpenCart only if your buying job matches “GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by” rather than Sellfy's shape. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than OpenCart's shape. Workflow advantage: OpenCart leans shared coverage; Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — OpenCart and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: OpenCart is GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59–$99/mo by secondary sources (confirm live). WooCommerce kee; Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce..
- Company-size focus: OpenCart (small-business, mid-market) vs Sellfy (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: OpenCart-leaning — vs Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace.
- Researched limits: OpenCart — Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Sellfy — none listed.

Limitations — OpenCart: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0; Managed cloud floors are not first-party confirmed here — confirm live before budgeting; Sellfy: —.

Poor-fit cases: OpenCart is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Hosting, security, and extension TCO are on you even when the license is $0 · Avoid OpenCart if you actually need Sellfy's motion (Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner i) · Avoid Sellfy if you actually need OpenCart's motion (GPL open-source PHP cart — free download core; optional managed cloud cited ~$59)
